tut.watch.arena: Your team is the circles. Field shows the whole map, Action follows the fights, All shows everything. Try Speed x2.
help.match.see: Your team: circles; theirs: hexagons. Field and Action show only what your team can see; All shows everything.
help.match.do: Pick a view: Field, Action or All. In Action, drag to look around; the camera returns after 5 seconds.
help.match.know: The result was decided before you watched. Watching, skipping or the view never changes it.
